surface: live browser guest redirects on http://localhost:3000 using agent-browser session ce4b2fe22b7f__u1

assertions.reason: Unauthenticated access to /guest/bookings?tab=upcoming redirected to sign-in with preserved safe return intent.

observations: Browser landed on Sign in · Nab a Table.
redirectedFrom preserved the original protected route path as /guest/bookings.
No browser page errors were reported by agent-browser errors.
Network capture on the redirected page showed the signin document request.

assertions.reason: Entering /guest canonicalized to the guest dashboard experience, which in the unauthenticated case redirects to sign-in using /guest/dashboard as the preserved return target.

observations: Opening /guest reported the Dashboard page title before redirect completion and ultimately resolved to the sign-in page.
Directly opening /guest/dashboard produced the same final sign-in URL with redirectedFrom=%2Fguest%2Fdashboard.
This indicates /guest resolves through the dashboard destination rather than a separate competing guest home.
No browser page errors were reported by agent-browser errors.

assertions.reason: The known local app.localhost runtime limitation reproduced: app-host guest route access entered a redirect loop instead of canonicalizing cleanly back to the root host in the live browser.

observations: curl -I http://app.localhost:3000/guest/bookings?tab=upcoming returned HTTP 308 with location: /guest/bookings?tab=upcoming, i.e. a relative redirect rather than an absolute root-host canonical URL.
agent-browser open on the app-host URL failed with net::ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS.
As a control, the same path on the root host loaded and redirected unauthenticated users to sign-in with preserved return intent.

blockers.description: Live local validation on app.localhost loops with too many redirects.
